card.name: Overdose and dialysis wording before treatment terms
card.fires_on: Small connecting or modifying words just before a treatment term, mostly in overdose sections: 'standard' before supportive measures, 'by' before hemodialysis, 'continuous' before peritoneal dialysis.

modes.label: Standard or advanced care
modes.description: Adjective right before supportive or life-support measures in overdose text.
modes.example: the person should be monitored, and<< standard>> supportive treatment applied as required.

modes.label: Removal by dialysis
modes.description: The word 'by' after 'removed' and before hemodialysis.
modes.example: Candesartan cannot be removed<< by>> hemodialysis.

modes.label: Linking word in a list or name
modes.description: A word such as 'Other' or '&' inside a drug-class heading or institution name.
modes.example: Ganciclovir (Valganciclovir), and<< Other>> Drugs that Undergo Renal Tubular
